# L-band vs C-band open water, all La Mojana dates

NISAR L2 GCOV products in this window are **PROVISIONAL** (processing type `PR`).
The open-water cut is **uncalibrated**. Sentinel-1 uses that same frozen number.
It is not an S1 calibration.

Seasonal water and breach water are not separated. This is not a map of the May 2024 breach.
Change classes were not recomputed. They remain degenerate under the frozen reference-date rule (issue #26).

## Reproduce

- Command: `uv run python -m gee_math.flood_polarimetric_math --lvsc`
- Generated (UTC): 2026-11-15T09:12:42Z
- Config: `config/preregistered.yaml`
- Config sha256: `8d61252171e05762856b94a0adca521ae6822e91d948b3deaf1edeb171893ea5`
- Open-water cut: VV < -18 dB (`flood.open_water_abs_hh_db`, read from the config above)
- Sentinel-1: `COPERNICUS/S1_GRD`, IW, VV and VH, median of every scene in the window
- Window: ±6 days. `filterDate` start is inclusive and end is exclusive, so the last included calendar day is the NISAR date plus 6 days.
- Sampling: `ee.data.computePixels` onto the cached analysis grid. No `.resample("nearest")`.
- NISAR open water: cached `water_extent_<date>.tif` value 1, checked against `local_cache/mojana/provenance.json` (generated 2026-11-15T02:20:33Z, config sha256 `c17c0ced08701ba05fb9ad94fd42d6e7882e87ed733d496c0b5b46370b4fcc65`). This command did not write that file or the cube bands.
- AOI [W, S, E, N]: [-75.4, 7.9, -74.2, 9.2]
- AOI source: config/bailasar.yaml aois.3_la_mojana_caregato
- Grid: EPSG:32618 grid, 90 m cells, 1471 columns by 1599 rows

A NISAR open-water pixel is missed when its Sentinel-1 VV is finite and is not below -18 dB. Pixels with missing Sentinel-1 stay missing and are not counted as misses. The miss denominator is the number of NISAR open-water pixels with finite Sentinel-1 VV. A date with no IW scene in the window is `no S1 within window` and is not given a zero miss.

`reports/mojana.md` recorded 3351 Sentinel-1 misses out of 4946 NISAR open-water pixels on 2026-07-11, from 14 IW GRD scenes in this same window *(measured, that report)*. This command reproduces that row.
